summary.en: Bajaj Finserv Ventures is the venture arm of financial-services group Bajaj Finserv, a 100% subsidiary investing in fintech, insurtech and the broader tech ecosystem. In 2026 the group launched 'Finserv Intelligence', a CVC effort committing ₹1,500–2,000 crore over five years to AI, quantum and cybersecurity startups (seed to Series B), with an IIT Bombay research tie-up.

summary.en: ICICI Venture is the alternative-asset-management arm and wholly owned subsidiary of ICICI Bank, one of India's largest private banks. It runs private equity, real estate, infrastructure and special-situations funds with over $6 billion in AUM since inception and 600+ investments; ICICI Bank anchors its funds. strategy.thesis: Corporate venture and startup-engagement vehicle of Reliance / Jio Platforms (telecom-and-digital). The Digital India Startup Fund (Rs 5,000 crore, 2016) plus the JioGenNext accelerator and Market Access Programme mentor and integrate early-stage startups into the Reliance/Jio ecosystem; GenNext Ventures takes up to ~15% stakes.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to JioGenNext accelerator / Market Access Programme via jiogennext.com.

summary.en: Reliance Jio's startup ecosystem combines the Rs 5,000 crore Digital India Startup Fund (2016) with the JioGenNext accelerator and Market Access Programme. Run under Reliance / Jio Platforms (telecom and digital), it has mentored 177 startups whose alumni have raised $545M+, and Reliance has acquired several (Embibe, Haptik, Milkbasket). GenNext Ventures takes up to ~15% stakes.

summary.en: The Airtel Startup Accelerator Program, launched by telecom operator Bharti Airtel in October 2019, takes minority strategic stakes in early-stage startups adjacent to Airtel's business (e.g., 25% in Lavelle Networks, 8.8% in Vahan, 7% in Cnergee, plus Aqilliz and Waybeo), offering access to Airtel's 340M+ retail and 1M+ business customers.

name.en: Brand Capital (Bennett, Coleman & Co. / Times Group)

strategy.thesis: Strategic investment arm of Bennett, Coleman & Co. (BCCL / Times Group), India's largest media conglomerate. Uses a media-for-equity model — providing advertising and brand-building across print, TV and digital in exchange for equity — making it the most active CVC by deal count in India.

application.how_to_apply: Engage via Brand Capital / Times Group business development.

summary.en: Brand Capital, founded in 2005, is the strategic investment arm of Bennett, Coleman & Co. (the Times of India / Times Group), India's largest media conglomerate. Using a media-for-equity model, it has invested USD 4bn+ in media value across 900+ companies, and is frequently cited as the most active corporate venture investor in India by deal count.

sources.title: $4bn media value invested in 900+ startups — Brand Capital International
sources.supports: USD 4bn+ media value, 900+ companies, media-for-equity model
sources.quote: Since 2005 the fund has invested USD 4bn+ worth of media in over 900 companies

sources.title: The Numbers Behind India's Burgeoning Corporate Venture Capital (CVC) Ecosystem
sources.supports: Most active CVC in India, strategic investment arm of BCCL/Times Group
sources.quote: Brand Capital — the strategic investment arm of Bennett Coleman & Co Ltd. (BCCL) and the Times Group, is the most active corporate venture capital investor in India.

verification_notes: Brand Capital invests primarily 'media-for-equity' (advertising in exchange for equity) rather than cash. The $4bn figure is cumulative media value invested, not a cash fund. Founded 2005; Brand Capital International (global vehicle) set up 2015. Light overlap with media/retail segment.
